Update_Hint: Updates are signed and installed for this user. Pixelery restarts after installation. Portable files are kept.
Update_Idle: Check manually for a new release.
Update_Error: Could not check or verify the update. Check your connection and try again.
Hero_Text: Pick styles, colors and sizes, then generate as many images as you need: test data for galleries and viewers, wallpapers or placeholders.
Section_StylesHint: Each image uses a selected style at random. Circle: select · Image or title: preview.
Section_ColorsHint: Palettes, background tone, level of detail and finishing effects.
Section_DimensionsHint: Choose one size, or enable multiple selection to cycle through sizes in order or choose them randomly.
Section_WatermarkHint: Your mark on every image: text, logo or both.
Section_OutputHint: Target folder, file names, formats and file dates.
Style_mesh-gradient: Soft, blurred color blobs like a modern wallpaper.
Style_aurora: Glowing curtains of light above a starry night sky.
Style_gradient-field: Linear, radial and conic gradients, sometimes layered or banded.
Style_bokeh: Out-of-focus light circles on a soft background.
Style_nebula: Colorful cosmic gas clouds with scattered stars.
Style_bauhaus: A grid of quarter circles, half circles, triangles and stripes.
Style_truchet: Tiles of arcs, lines or triangles forming endless mazes.
Style_low-poly: A faceted triangle mesh shaded along a gradient.
Style_subdivision: Recursively split rectangles: classic Mondrian or modern tiles.
Style_circle-packing: Non-overlapping circles in many sizes, filled, ringed or outlined.
Style_memphis: 80s confetti of squiggles, zigzags and bold shapes.
Style_isometric: Shaded 3D cubes in an isometric pattern.
Style_halftone: Rotated dot screens layered like print separations.
Style_kaleidoscope: Shapes mirrored around the center in symmetric wedges.
Style_op-art: Moiré rings, warped stripes and bulging checkerboards.
Style_flow-field: Thousands of particle trails following an invisible current.
Style_marble: Swirling, warped noise like marble or liquid paint.
Style_topographic: Contour lines of an imaginary landscape, optionally tinted.
Style_watercolor: Translucent washes of layered, bleeding pigment.
Style_paper-layers: Stacked paper cut-outs with soft shadows.
Style_ridgelines: Stacked mountain lines like the famous pulsar plot.
Style_stained-glass: Voronoi cells with dark lead lines.
Style_plasma: Interfering sine waves, smooth or posterized.
Style_fractal: Julia sets and Mandelbrot close-ups with smooth coloring.
Style_harmonograph: Damped pendulum curves and spirographs drawn as fine threads.
Style_synthwave: A striped retro sun, mountains and a neon grid.
Style_glitch: RGB split, displaced slices and scanlines.
Style_pixel-mosaic: Posterized pixel mosaics or rows of symmetric sprites.
Style_neon-glow: Glowing neon tubes on a dark backdrop.
Style_rotating-snakes: Rings of graded segments that seem to rotate (after Kitaoka).
Style_cafe-wall: Shifted rows of tiles whose parallel lines look wedge-shaped.
Style_scintillating-grid: White dots at grid crossings that flash dark, or the Hermann grid.
Style_fraser-spiral: Concentric circles of twisted cord that look like a spiral.
Style_zoellner: Parallel lines with short hatches that seem tilted.
Style_ouchi: Discs of crossed checks that seem to float and slide.
Style_kanizsa: Pac-man shapes that make never-drawn triangles and polygons appear.
Style_impossible-figures: Penrose tribars that cannot exist in three dimensions.
Colors_PalettesHint: Curated palettes are hand-picked; the others are generated from color theory for endless variety.
Colors_UseSet: Use this palette set for generation
Colors_SetSaveError: Could not save the palette set.
Colors_SetLoadError: Could not load the file. Select a JSON set with eight valid palettes.
Size_OrientationHint: Applies to all sizes, including fixed presets. Square images stay square.
Size_LongEdgesHint: Image width in landscape; in portrait, this becomes the image height. Combined with the selected aspect ratios.
Size_FixedHint: Choose a preset instead of an aspect ratio and horizontal resolution. In multiple-selection mode, both are combined.
Output_NameHint: Select a saved pattern or add a new one. Click a placeholder to insert it. Use \ or / for subfolders. The extension is added automatically.
Output_NameAddError: Enter a valid pattern. You can save up to 100 patterns.
Output_SpreadDatesHint: For test images: distributes file timestamps and capture dates randomly within the selected period, including both complete months. When off, file timestamps retain the actual creation time.
Output_NameNotUnique: Without {n}, {seed}, {rand} or {guid} names repeat; duplicates get a numeric suffix.
Output_NamePreviewUnavailable: Examples appear once styles, sizes and formats are selected.
Output_WriteExif: Write date taken and camera (EXIF, JPEG only)
Output_ReferenceDateHint: Applies to {now} and, when timestamp spreading is off, the image date and {date}. Empty = today. The From/To period is independent.
Name_Token_n: running number, format with zeros for padding
Name_Token_seed: image seed (hex) to reproduce the image
Name_Token_date: image date (spread dates if enabled), .NET date format
Name_Token_now: time of the run, .NET date format
Name_Token_fmt: file format: jpg, png or webp
Name_Token_total: number of images in the run
Slide_Intro: Shows new images one after another with the styles and colors selected on the left. Nothing is saved.
Slide_SeedHint: The same seed shows the same sequence of images again.
Slide_Uses: Uses {0} styles, {1} palette families and {2} backgrounds from the configuration.
Slide_KeyFull: Switch between full screen and window
Slide_Hint: Esc end · Space pause · ← → browse · I info · F full screen
Run_ThreadsHint: This PC has {0} logical processors. Each thread renders one image at a time.
Run_SettingsFileHint: Shares generation settings and the selected filename pattern. The output folder, threads and other saved patterns stay local.
Run_SettingsExported: Settings exported with seed {0} and reference date {1}.
Run_SettingsImportError: Could not load the file. Select a settings file exported from Pixelery.
Run_SettingsOtherVersion: The file comes from Pixelery {0}, this is {1}. Some images can look different.
Run_SettingsMissingFont: The watermark font {0} is not installed. A replacement font is used.
Run_PreviewOff: Live preview is turned off in the settings.
Validation_Palettes: Select at least one palette family.
Validation_Details: Select at least one level of detail.
Validation_Sizes: Select at least one size: aspect ratio, orientation and long edge, or a fixed dimension.
Validation_Formats: Select at least one file format.
Validation_DateRange: Choose a valid period: From must not be after To.
Validation_WatermarkImage: A watermark image layer has no readable image file.
Wm_Apply: Add the watermark to all generated images
Wm_InSlideshow: Also show it in the slideshow
Wm_Inactive: Inactive: not added to the images
Wm_NoSelection: Add a text or image layer to get started.
Wm_TextHint: Placeholders are filled in for every image. Press Enter for a new line.
Wm_ImageHint: PNG files with transparency work best, e.g. a logo.
Settings_LivePreview: Show a live preview of the latest image
Settings_PreviewsFollowColors: Style previews use the selected colors
Settings_OpenFolderWhenDone: Open the target folder when a run finishes
Settings_AboutText: Mass generator for abstract images, built with Flowery.WinUI and SkiaSharp.
Shortcut_Start: Start (generate or slideshow, depending on the tab)
Shortcut_ToggleStyle: Select or deselect the focused style card
Tour_StylesText: Pick the art styles here. Each image uses one of the selected styles at random. Click a preview to see the style large.
Tour_ColorsText: Choose palette families and background tones, or a fixed palette set. Level of detail and finishing effects are here too.
Tour_DimensionsText: Set aspect ratios, sizes and orientation. With several sizes, Pixelery cycles through them or picks them at random.
Tour_WatermarkText: Optional: add text and image layers to every image.
Tour_OutputText: Choose the target folder, the file name pattern, the formats and the file dates.
Tour_RunText: Set the number of images. The same seed creates the same images again. Import and export take your settings to another PC. Start begins the run.
Tour_SlideshowText: Preview the selected styles full screen, one image after another, without saving anything.
Tour_SettingsText: Change the theme, language and size here. You can also show this tour again.
